heading: Rhea Ripley’s journey: How did she become one of WWE’s biggest stars?
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: Rhea Ripley’s path from the independent wrestling scene in Australia to a successful career in the WWE, winning big gold titles, developing her character and appearing in high-profile WrestleMania matches. Ripley trained at Riot City Wrestling before working her way through NXT UK and NXT to the main WWE roster. Her transformation into “Mami” and involvement in The Judgement Day also raised her profile globally.
